column1: # Source: NVIDIA product datasheets and architecture whitepapers; Dally (Hot Chips 2023) (@dally2023; @nvidia2017gpu; @NVIDIA2020; @choquette2023; @nvidia2024blackwell)
# Epistemic: measured (vendor-advertised single-package peak throughput ceilings from official product datasheets)

# Computation: Direct datasheet transcription; structured-sparsity entries equal 2x dense Tensor Core peaks (A100 INT8 sparse = 2 * 624 = 1248 TOPS; H100 SXM FP8 sparse = 2 * 1979 = 3958 TFLOP/s; B200 HGX FP8 sparse = 2 * 4500 = 9000 TFLOP/s).

# Notes: Mixes numerical formats (FP32 -> INT8 -> FP16 Tensor -> INT8 sparse -> FP8 sparse) following Dally (2023) to show advertised headline capability rather than iso-precision scaling. Tesla K20X launched Nov 2012 (BD-06397-001); Tesla M40 launched Nov 2015 (BD-07784-001); Tesla P40 launched Sep 2016.
